declared.title: Undoing suggestive influence on memory: The reversibility of the eyewitness misinformation effect
declared.foundIn: reports/memory-rewritten/counter-evidence.md (card 2); OpenAlex search « suggestive influence misinformation completely undone original event details restored » (2026-11-26)

population: participants in three misinformation experiments (a witnessed incident, then misleading details); sample sizes and country not in the abstract

findings.text: With a special procedure (telling people there may be two conflicting answers, and testing the detail and its source separately), three experiments completely undid the influence of misleading details on reports

support.sentence: Based on a memory conversion theoretical framework and associated refined assessment strategy, we report three experiments to demonstrate that suggestive influence can be completely undone.

limits: same second author as blank-2014-postwarning (Blank): not independent of it
the effect was there first (« initially established »), then undone by the procedure, not on its own: the original detail can survive, not that it always does
full text closed, not read: sample sizes and countries unknown; in one experiment the effect was undone 5 weeks later (abstract)
the abstract's two result sentences (« eliminated », « restored to the level of non-misled control ») are cut by the tool at « (Exp. 3) »: its aim-and-conclusion sentence is cited
